article.headline: Quante Berry’s 20 help Lamar beat Robert Morris 87-62 at Jacksonville Classic
article.description: — Quante Berry scored 20 points as Lamar beat Robert Morris 87-62 on Tuesday at the Jacksonville Classic.
article.linkText: Quante Berry’s 20 help Lamar beat Robert Morris 87-62 at Jacksonville Classic
article.story: JACKSONVILLE, Fla. -- — Quante Berry scored 20 points as Lamar beat Robert Morris 87-62 on Tuesday at the Jacksonville Classic. Berry shot 8 of 13 from the field, including 1 for 3 from 3-point range, and went 3 for 3 from the free-throw line for the Cardinals (4-2). Niccolo Moretti scored 18 points and added eight assists. Dominic Eason finished 7 of 8 from the field to finish with 15 points. Jalik Dunkley finished with 14 points and four assists for the Colonials (2-5). K.J. Garris added nine points and six rebounds for Robert Morris. Ta’Zir Smith finished with eight points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
